summary: Collections no longer run a second time each day outside your pipeline.

fixes.title: No extra daily collection outside the pipeline
fixes.text: Endpoint, Identity and Azure collections no longer run a second time a day on their own timer. Installations that run jobs on their own schedules keep their timers.

fixes.title: Jobs page shows collections as pipeline steps
fixes.text: The Jobs page shows these three collections as pipeline steps again, and saving the pipeline keeps them.

fixes.title: Collections outside the pipeline are reported
fixes.text: A daily check now warns about any collection that did not run inside the pipeline and was not started by a person.
